review_description: After signing the contract and emailing it to them on the 7th October they contacted me yesterday saying there was a problem with their quoting system and they are only just processing the order now. So it still hasn’t been installed.
Full system install was faultless and very professional. Communication from day 1 was spot on.

After the initial mistake of using a neighbours roof to generate the quote, the process has been brilliant.  All the changes I had for the number of panels to the inverter options, nothing seemed like a hardship and was actioned promptly.The installation was great with everyone being polite and keeping us up to date. There was a number of installers/tradies onsite that turned up on time and all did their part.  The complete install finished in less than 6 hours.  At all times we were asked what we wanted or needed and the team cleaned up and would not know they had been except for an Inverter on the wall.The only negative I would have is that the scheduling does not give you a lot of notice, but it was not an issue for us and understand that weather plays a part in the install.Also if you have a tile roof, as was mentioned by others in doing my research, it is a good idea to have at least 6 or 7 spare tiles as it can be a challenge to get them up if they are secured properly!

Workmanship was first class and the team were very experienced and thorough.  I had two hick ups which I will comment for people and future installations. I was on a Synergy Business plan which meant I had to change back to residential to get on the Debs scheme - which I had no idea about and to do that Synergy came an installed a new smart metre without my knowledge or consent and then threatened to charge me for th privilege next bill cycle as I cancelled my business plan. We had to redo the Solar application because of this which was taken care by JFK. Also you need to locate spare tiles, which I had to find at recycled tiles yards as they don't make mine anymore and I only had 24hr notice to get them. Just a few hidden hick ups and we were back on track. Thanks everyone involved.
